name: purchase_contract
summary: Commercial agreements, contracted price schedules, value ceilings, obligations and consumption tracking
description: Authoritative contract and framework-agreement management for the Procurement module. Owns the master commercial agreement (fixed, framework, blanket, rate-card, volume, supply, support, subscription, milestone and consignment types), its versioned lifecycle (draft to pending approval to active, with suspend/resume, explicit versioned renewal and amendment, close and cancel), contracted price schedules with quantity tiers and indexation used to validate purchase-order and invoice prices server-side, SLA/monitoring obligations, and an append-only consumption ledger that tracks committed, invoiced and credited value against a ceiling. Exceeding the ceiling is a block/warn signal, never a silent approval. Holding a contract does not bypass requisition approval or budget control: it only supplies contracted rates and a ceiling the downstream engines respect. Physical goods remain owned by Inventory and payables by Accounting.
author: Nexa
